subject: Arte
description_pt: Explorar e reconhecer elementos constitutivos das artes visuais (ponto, linha, forma, cor, espaço, movimento etc.).

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos constitutivos das artes visuais como ponto, linha, forma e cor
components.description_en: Identify constitutive elements of visual arts such as point, line, shape, and color
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos constitutivos das artes visuais como espaço e movimento
components.description_en: Identify constitutive elements of visual arts such as space and movement
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

components.description_pt: Explorar como elementos constitutivos das artes visuais são usados em composições artísticas
components.description_en: Explore how constitutive elements of visual arts are used in artistic compositions

components.description_pt: Reconhecer o papel de cada elemento visual na construção de significado dentro de uma obra de arte
components.description_en: Recognize the role of each visual element in constructing meaning within an artwork

cc_matches.description: Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
